subject: Web Development
title: The ES4 Disaster
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The ES4 Disaster.

hook.text: In 2007, the committee tried to create ECMAScript 4. It nearly destroyed the language.

buildup.text: ES4 proposed classes, types, modules, and generators — a massive overhaul of the language.

discovery.text: Microsoft and Yahoo argued it was too ambitious. The committee split into warring factions.

twist.text: ES4 was scrapped entirely. Years of work were thrown away due to political gridlock.

climax.text: The failure taught the committee to evolve JavaScript gradually instead of revolutionizing it.

punchline.text: A failed revolution led to steady evolution.
